finalPrompt: Create one original unofficial fan-made full-body static game plate of the licensed 2020 Samurai Predator from Predator: Hunting Grounds. Use a strict three-quarter side profile facing right on a pure opaque #00FF00 background. Preserve ochre mottled skin, black temple-style dreadlocks, worn bronze lamellar Yautja armor, layered shoulder and thigh guards, cord ties and an ornate kabuto/oni-inspired functional biomask. The official Predator Katana is the only prominent weapon: one continuous single-edged blade held low in a clean closed grip, with its scabbard secured at the waist. Keep the whole character, sword, hands, dreadlocks and feet inside the portrait frame with padding. No floor, shadow, scenery, text, logo, UI, watermark, collage, extra limbs, malformed hands, extra or fused fingers, multiple swords, axe, combistick, Alpha bone armor, checkerboard or fake transparency.
